title: ARV Answer
description: How a set of moments answers one question: the answer shape, how much of the question it covers, and the ordered moments with verbatim evidence. Discovery data: the forbidden-field rule applies.

arv.description: ARV version. Every ARV object carries "arv": "1.0".

question.description: The question as the origin understood it.

shape.description: single_moment: one moment answers it. multi_moment: several moments each answer part of it. steps: ordered steps to follow. overview: a broad summary across the source.

coverage.description: complete: the references answer the whole question. partial: they answer part of it. best_available: the closest the source has, not a direct answer.

references.description: Moments in the order a consumer shows them.

moment_uri.description: arv:{asset_id}#t={start_ms},{end_ms}. The canonical snapped range is the moment's identity.

role.description: answer: it answers the question. supporting: it adds context. step: one step of a steps answer.

step_index.description: 1-based position of the step. Only on role step.

span.description: Verbatim evidence that justifies the reference. Lies inside the referenced range.

actions.description: Links the publisher offers with this answer.
